notes.subject: i yɛrɛ
notes.rationale: יתאמרו (hitpa'el) ye 'i yɛrɛ fasa' ye — nɔnabila min bɔ Heburukan kɔgɔjɔcogo la, a farala a kan

notes.subject: עתק
notes.rationale: עתק: 'kuma jugu-min-bɔla-tɛ' (impudence) san 'kuma kɔrɔ' (saying, YLT) san 'kura min bɛ fɔ ka jiji' (LXX 'boldness') — 'ɲɛtigiya-kan' ta

notes.subject: יביעו
notes.rationale: nabega-daɲɛ: kuma bɛ bɔ i n'a fɔ ji taabu ye — ji ta bi Bamanankan na walasa o ɲɛ dɔ ka to

translation: U bɛ kuma bɔ i n'a fɔ ji ye, u bɛ fɔ kuma ɲɛtigiya-kan na; mɔgɔ minnu bɛ juguya baara kɛ bɛɛ, u bɛ ⟨i yɛrɛ⟩ fasa.

tokens.gloss: u bɛ kuma bɔ i n'a fɔ ji ye
